## Description and Rationale

Jack and Chris - a father/son duo, Chris specialising in data science and Jack a Flight Operations expert.
We decided to enter for a bit of fun! And we thought our combined experience could create an elegant solution to the issue!

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: United Kingdom
* Number of team members: 2

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(gt)

gt(tibble::tribble(
  ~id, ~forename,  ~surname,   ~affiliation,
   1L,    "Jack", "Ballard",  "Independent",
   2L,   "Chris", "Ballard", "Justified AI"
)
) |> cols_label(id = md("**ID**"), forename = md("**Forename**"), surname ~ md("**Surname**"), affiliation ~ md("**Affiliation**"))
```
